blocks.text: AI-powered spreadsheet that replaces formulas with plain-language insights

Rows rethinks the spreadsheet by adding an AI layer that understands your data. Instead of writing complex formulas, you can ask questions in plain English: "What was our best-performing channel last month?" or "Show me the trend for MRR over the past 6 months." The AI generates the analysis, chart, or summary instantly.

For data-driven startup teams, Rows bridges the gap between raw data and actionable insights. Connect your data sources - Google Analytics, Stripe, HubSpot, databases - and Rows keeps everything synchronized. No more exporting CSVs and manually updating spreadsheets.
The collaboration features match what you would expect from a modern tool. Real-time editing, commenting, and sharing make Rows suitable for team workflows rather than just individual analysis.
Ask questions about your data in plain English and get instant answers
Live connections to Google Analytics, Stripe, HubSpot, and databases
AI creates visualizations and charts from your data automatically
Multiple users editing simultaneously with comments and sharing
Schedule data refreshes and automated report generation
Programmatic access to build custom integrations

Rows removes the technical barrier between data and decisions. For startup teams without dedicated analysts, the AI-powered insights surface patterns that would otherwise require SQL skills or BI tools.
Our team can integrate Rows into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
